The session split the driver's answer writer, the crate-private module that writes every driver answer by hand as JSON, by answer family into seven private child modules: snapshot, diff, caused, layout, graph, actions and lint.
Every carrier's answers stay byte for byte unchanged: the 49 literal JSON pins pass, and the stand replay compares both committed Counter checks whole with every kept answer, 5 passed.
No public symbol, crate re-export, caller path, dependency, schema key, field order or written byte moved; the engine document was left whole and the stand checks and flows are untouched.
The writer's 9 unit tests moved out of line into a #[path] test file under the same json::tests names, so escher-driver's inline tests drop by 9 and its #[path] test files gain one file and 9 tests.
CI read green 17/17 at attempt 3, after two attempts in which the iOS job was cancelled with no runner, and escher-driver coverage reads 97.68 % against its 97 % floor.

The CI matrix running every job: an iOS job that no runner took was cancelled twice and passed on its third run. This was re-run, not fixed, and the gate's rule itself did not change.
Dependency security: no crate, lockfile entry, version, licence or audit ignore changed.
Outbound network, fetch, CORS, same-origin, iframe, stylesheet and script-loading rows: no network or engine code changed.
The session socket transport, its bounds, closed grammar, owner-only access and idle expiry, and the MCP stdio transport, its errors and its bounds: the transport and validation code is unchanged.
Recording, kept-check and state directory lifecycle rows (owner-only, deletes only its own files, never named): no file handling changed, and no check file was edited.
Select list, password painting, range input, accessibility adapter, aria and engine input handling rows: no engine or DOM code changed.

Secret management, CI tokens, publish guards and signing material: no workflow, secret or publish job changed.

The driver verb schema, the argument kinds, the CLI flags, the roles and the exit codes: no verb, argument, flag or exit code moved.

The driver's hand-written JSON answer writer was split by answer family into seven private child modules (snapshot, diff, caused, layout, graph, actions, lint); the parent keeps the primitives, the shot, coverage, the outcome dispatch, refusal, session error and the session lines.
Every carrier's answer stays byte for byte unchanged: no written key, order or byte moved, no public symbol, re-export or caller path changed, no dependency, schema or committed check changed.
The writer's inline unit test module moved out of line into a #[path] test file beside it; its 9 tests and 49 literal JSON pins stand there with the test paths json::tests::* unchanged.
Moved items reached by the parent or the tests are widened to pub(super) and no further; the rest stay private to their child.
Measured: the unit tests 9 passed, stand replay 5 passed, the fast and doc CI legs green, the session agent-run passed; CI green 17/17 at attempt 3 after two iOS jobs cancelled with no runner; escher-driver line coverage 97.68 % against its 97 % floor.

body_fields.what: the driver's answer writer, written by hand in a crate-private module — the JSON primitives (string, number, list, object), the shot without its image, the coverage line, the outcome dispatch, the refusal and session error answers and the session lines; edited, now the parent of the family modules
the snapshot answer family of the driver's answer writer — a snapshot node with its schema fields, its reading word and masked value; new
the acting call result family of the driver's answer writer — settled, busy and the snapshot diff of changed node states; new
the caused items family of the driver's answer writer — the caused and caused-past items an acting call carries (panic, error, log); new
the layout verb answer family of the driver's answer writer — placement, placer, shift and size-cause words and lengths of a layout explanation; new
the graph answer family of the driver's answer writer — graph nodes and task state with declared and confirmed writes, holding no value; new
the actions answer family of the driver's answer writer — one actionable node with its owner, holding no value; new
the lint findings family of the driver's answer writer — one finding with its defect, bounds and reason; new

the driver answer writer's unit tests (json::tests), moved out of line to a #[path] test file — table-driven tests with literal expected JSON pins for strings, numbers, nodes, each outcome, layout words, refusals, session errors, session answers and the coverage line; new

body: The convention that unit tests sit inline in their source file (inline cfg(test) modules): the driver answer writer's 9 tests moved out of line to a #[path] test file, a further instance of the out-of-line exception.
The rule that a split test module keeps its paths: the moved tests keep json::tests::* names, 9 of them, unchanged.
The rule that shared test modules or #[path] test children are no test target: the new test file is a child of the crate's lib, not a target.
Expected values pinned as literals: the 49 literal JSON pins of the driver answers moved with the tests and pass unchanged.
Table-driven tests assert their row count and carry a row index: the writer's table tests moved whole, their bodies unchanged.
Driver JSON answers contract items (number, masked value) and the snapshot node contract: the code writing them moved to family modules, bytes unchanged.
The driver refusal causes, their printed form and fixed strings, and session error messages as fixed text: the refusal and session error writers stay in the parent, tested by the moved tests.
Lint defects and lint findings order: the finding writer moved to the lint family module, its output unchanged.
Every layout reader word read on a fixture and the layout verb answer: the placer, shift, cause words and placement moved to the layout family module; the words test moved with them.
Graph answer holds no value and actions answer holds no value: the graph and actions writers moved to their own family modules, unchanged.
Acting call result and caused items on an acting call (run, diff, changed node states): the diff and caused writers moved, unchanged.
The coverage line shape and owner: the coverage line writer stays in the parent, its test moved out of line.
Per-crate line coverage floors: escher-driver reads 97.68 % against its 97 % floor; the split children read 98.91 % to 100 %.
Recorded checks replayed as tests and committed checks byte-equal to the recording: stand replay of both committed Counter checks compared whole, 5 passed, checks untouched.
Bridge tests without widening visibility: items moved to children are widened to pub(super) only, some only because the out-of-line tests call them (layout placement among them).
Doc leg gates a public doc comment edit: two doc comments now stand on their own items (graph node, shot without image), text unchanged, the doc leg green.
Capability statement pinned to the driver schema and claim section names held to the schema: no schema, field or capability changed; no capability claimed.
Stable tree serialization: the hand-written serialization of the driver answers keeps every key and order.

body_fields.fact: Items a split module's children expose to the parent or to the out-of-line tests are widened to pub(super) and no further; the tests name the parent's former imports instead of reaching them through use super::*.
A CI job cancelled with no runner acquired is re-run, not fixed, and recorded before each re-run; a red on anything but a missing runner stops the pass.
